canaries.scope: 31 reflexible windows (disjoint from the 5 chiral windows)
canaries.info_content_note: necessary-condition health check (定理の必要条件ゆえ必ず成立) -- carries zero NEW information (per prediction_summary.note in the source cert: 'health check, not a real test').
